data.rotor_policy: Use the classical high-temperature nonlinear rigid-rotor partition function. Sigma counts proper rigid rotations that only permute identical isotopically labeled nuclei. Treat source geometry as near-symmetric when the atom-matched proper-rotation RMSD is at most the stated tolerance. The only element-preserving nonidentity candidate for this triatomic geometry swaps the two hydrogen sites.
data.counterfactual_boundary: Hold the Cartesian geometry fixed under isotopic mass substitution. Recenter by the mass-dependent center of mass before forming each inertia tensor. The symmetry convention changes but no geometry optimization or new electronic calculation is implied.
data.entropy_boundary: Compare only rotational entropy under the declared classical isotope-labeled convention,with equilibrium symmetry counting;ignore nuclear-spin statistical weights,ortho/para restrictions,vibrational isotope shifts,translation,electronic entropy and all other thermochemistry. Apply the new sigma to the same inertia convention as the archive;do not interpret archive sigma=1 as an undocumented software error.

provenance.kind: authentic published computational geometry/convention projection with controlled isotope-mass counterfactual
provenance.generation: Lossless selected original published computational-data projection; no synthetic numerical observations. Source captures identify the original bytes. Any derived coordinate or format metadata is explicitly marked. These are computational inputs,not new experimental measurements.
provenance.units: Coordinatesangstrom;massesu;inertiau*angstrom²;temperatureK;entropycal/(mol K). Only inertia-product ratios enter entropy differences,so the common inertia-unit scale cancels.

source_capture.role: Genuine published scientific source artifact / library fixture; byte provenance verified, physical completeness and normalization require individual inspection; no expected answers used
